# shadcn/ui

The interface components in `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/ui` started
from components that the pinned shadcn CLI 4.18.0 generated from the shadcn/ui
registry (`apps/desktop/shadcn-preset.json` lists them) and were then adapted
for AoE2RMSIDE. shadcn/ui is Copyright (c) 2023 shadcn and is distributed
under the MIT License; its license text is kept in `LICENSE.txt`.
